shortBulletSummary: Bitcoin drops below $80,000, market cap decreases to $2.66 trillion, and spot Bitcoin ETFs record $773.5 million in two-day outflows.
Markets anticipate the Federal Reserve FOMC meeting on October 27-28, expecting interest rates to remain unchanged while monitoring future guidance.
Upcoming US economic data including September PCE inflation and Q3 GDP could complicate monetary easing due to expected inflation increases.
Middle East risks driving crude oil prices higher raise inflation concerns, while upcoming US midterm elections introduce regulatory uncertainty for crypto.
Bitmine Immersion Technologies reports 6.05 million ETH holdings ($15 billion total holdings) and the Ripple Swell 2026 conference commences.
